_what: ReelCast Lab shipped defaults. Do not edit this file: put your own values in ~/.config/reelcast-lab/settings.json (same keys, only the ones you change). Paths may use ~, {kit_root} (the folder that holds engine/) and {content_root}. REELCAST_LAB_ROOT overrides content_root. REELCAST_LAB_CONFIG names a JSON file merged on top of everything (tests and the practice run use it).

brand._what: Your look lives in dir: caption_preset.json, end-card.png, fonts/, voice.md, framing.md. Anything missing there falls back to the neutral file in default_dir.

framing._what: top_crop: the share of the raw frame height cut off the top (0.0 keeps the whole frame). eye_line: where the eyes sit, as a share of the raw frame height.

offer._what: The one thing your videos currently sell, if any. The analyst uses it for the ad verdict. Leave both empty when there is none.

text_rules._what: caption.txt and the on-screen hook fail the quality check when they contain any of these strings. The defaults are the em dash and the en dash.

_model_safety: How the two Claude runs are boxed in (do not loosen these). --restricted ignores your own Claude settings files and keeps the file tools inside the two working folders. --strict-mcp-config loads none of your connectors. The run's folder is <run>/work and the video's Edited folder is added with --add-dir; the file tools are only auto-approved there because Write and Edit are not in --allowedTools. --settings turns on Claude Code's sandbox for every shell command: no network, no writes outside those two folders, no reading the listed secrets folders, and no way to run a command outside the sandbox. The Edit deny rules also cover Write.

command: Read the edit brief in the file edit_brief.md in your working folder and follow it exactly. It is a headless run: do not ask questions.
Read the analysis brief in the file analysis_brief.md in your working folder and follow it exactly. It is a headless run: do not ask questions.

_glossary: Words the transcriber often gets wrong, fixed on screen only (timing is never touched). One entry per word: {"display": "how it should look", "heard": ["what the transcriber writes", "another spelling"], "action": "replace" or "flag", "note": "optional, shown to the editor"}. "replace" fixes it every time. "flag" leaves it and asks the editor to decide. A replace entry may add "when_prev": [words] and "when_next": [words]: it is then replaced only next to one of those words and flagged everywhere else.
_coming_later: Posting, reading the numbers, picking a winner and the dashboard are coming later. They ship switched off: publisher and reader stay not_wired and auto_post_enabled stays false, so every video stops at the review hold.

notify._what: true shows a macOS notification when a video is ready or needs you. false (the default) only writes the message to Lab_Data/notify-outbox.log.
